message: 愛憎の有効利用

name: Nanaka
message: 「Knead, knead...」

name: Ria
message: 「You really look like a pro at this, Nanaka-chan.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Teehee, I'm always making it for Synn and Paqy, after all.」
In the Student Council room after school, Nanaka is kneading buckwheat flour.
Yuugiri-an got a shipment of fresh autumn soba flour, and she wanted her friends in the Student Council to be the first to taste it.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh? That Mr. Soba isn't gray, is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte, freshly harvested soba actually has a slight greenish tint to it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-Is that so!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「But the instant Mr. Soba that I sneak out to eat in the middle of the night behind Jiiya's back is gray, it is.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hold on, Lolotte-san. Lumping that fake stuff together with the real thing is rude to Nanaka-san!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's fine, it's fine. Instant noodles have their own charm, I think.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hang tight just a little longer. I'll boil up some 100% buckwheat soba for everyone's snack.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oka~y\s07 So excited, so excited!」

name: Ria
message: 「We need plenty of boiling water, right? I'll get that started on the portable stove!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Thank you very much. Knead, knead, knead...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Knead, knead... and knead! Huff, huff, huff...!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, aren't you getting tired?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, it's double the amount she kneads every morning, so it's gotta be tough on Soba's slender arms.」

name: Synn
message: 「Let me do half of it for you, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「This is nothing! My old man kneads ten times this much without breaking a sweat!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, how pathetic. You can't even support the treasurer, and you call yourself the Student Council president?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Vice President-san? Student Council titles don't have anything to do with making soba, do they?」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hmph, I'll show you what true assistance looks like!」

name: Misa
message: 「Ahem... Listen to me, Nanaka-san. I often bake bread at home by hand.」

name: Misa
message: 「The trick to kneading dough is to picture the face of someone you dislike. That way, you can really put your strength into it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see, that's a brilliant idea!」

name: Misa
message: 「Incidentally, I always think of a certain boy... *chuckle*」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Misa? Why are you smirking while looking at me?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Someone I hate, someone I hate... Bubuzuke, Bubuzuke, Bubuzuke...」

name: Ria
message: 「Y-You immediately jump straight to associating her with Akane-chan, huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gwah!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Doryaaaa~!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's true! I feel insane power surging through me!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Thanks, Misa! Looks like I'm gonna make some crazy delicious soba!」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I'm just glad I could be of help...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, don't get creeped out when you're the one who taught her that!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Fueee~. Food tastes so delicious when everyone eats together happily, so is it really okay for the prep work to be filled with resentment and hatred?」

name: Ria
message: 「U-Ummm. I wonder about that?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Rii-a, are ya in here? About that kintsuba and gintsuba matter from the other day--」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, Akane-chan!? Don't come in right--」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh good, so ya were in here after all.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha... She came right in...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Bubuzukeeee~~! Don't think you can keep playing me like a fiddle with that cool look on your face all the time!」

name: Misa
message: 「N-Nanaka-san is so absorbed in kneading that she hasn't noticed Misasagi-senpai!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「...Just what on earth is she doin' over there?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oryaaaa~! What's so great about the Wagashi Club anywayyy!」

name: Ria
message: 「Akane-chan, it's not what it looks like, okay? Nanaka-chan is just making soba... right, right?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Very well, I grasp the situation.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「In that case... shhh.」
Misasagi-senpai presses her index finger to her lips, hushing us. Then, just like that, she tiptoes behind Nanaka.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Bubuzuke, bubuzuke, grown-up bubuzuke!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Phew, finished kneading.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Has there ever been soba-making this refreshing? No, there hasn't. That's what you call a rhetorical question.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Now then, shall we cut it into noodles?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You betcha.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, whaaa?! Bubuzuke, how long have you been standing there?!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Hmph, if you let a traditional Japanese confection sneak up behind you, Western sweets aren't all that impressive either.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This no longer makes any sense whatsoever.」

name: Synn
message: 「A-A sharp blade just popped out of her folding fan?!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Just kidding.」
As she said that, a soba knife appeared.
Then what was that sound just now?

name: Misasagi
message: 「Even so, I am a sheltered young lady, after all. I've never used a knife like this before.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「See, what'd I tell ya! Just shut up and leave it to me.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「What a lovely soba aroma. Just as I thought, you're much better at this, Nanaka-han~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Flattery won't change the fact that you're my enemy! Here, thanks for waiting!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Much obliged.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yay♪ It looks delicious. Let's boil it right away and eat.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「At least allow me to handle the boiling, won't you?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No way! I'll do it!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh my. How very kind of you.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's not kindness!」
And so, in the end, Nanaka ended up making the whole thing.
Even making sure to serve Misasagi-senpai, whom she treats as a rival. Is this what they call the nature of the service industry?

name: Synn
message: 「Slurp, slurp... Delicious!」
Still, the soba Nanaka makes really is the best!
